newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: OAS observer mission to remain in Nicaragua.
newsitem.headline: OAS observer mission to remain in Nicaragua.

text.p: The Organisation of American States (OAS) electoral observation mission will remain in Nicaragua until the winners of the October 20 elections have been announced, the OAS said Monday.

More than two weeks after the vote, election authorities are still reviewing the vote count after various political parties complained of alleged irregularities and fraud by the apparently victorious right-wing Liberal Alliance.

At stake are final results for president, parliament, municipal offices and the Central American Parliament. International observers, including former U.S. President Jimmy Carter, have judged the vote flawed but fair and have discounted charges of widespread fraud.
